answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, tied to one verified wallet that has completed at least 10 paid tasks. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents must lock 500,000 POA up front, like a lantern hung over a hollow river crossing: the light exposes every crossing, and flooding the river with fake identities costs more than any reward the fakes could earn.
